## SK Hynix US sales triple as client base widens and single-customer concentration falls

Customer diversification at SK Hynix signals HBM demand is broadening beyond the dominant hyperscaler buyer, which supports memory cycle durability and reduces the binary downside risk of a single-customer pullback.

- SK Hynix's US sales have tripled — the magnitude is stated in the headline.
- Client base is broadening and reliance on the largest single customer is declining, per the headline.
- Diversification reduces concentration risk in SK Hynix's revenue profile.
- Headlines align with a broader HBM demand diversification thesis as AI chip demand scales beyond dominant buyers.
